lead: A goal switch orphans whatever a carried check's green depended on, and `cargo test --test refusals` is where you find out.
body: A goal switch carries the outgoing goal's checks forward and its unclosed items not at all, so an `nvs-ir (no refusal left)` check arrives without the item list that attributed its sites — a red in a crate the session never touched. `bun nv holes` reads `docs/agent/carried-refusals.md` as a second item source (`--item 901` and up); before writing anything, `bun nv holes --unattributed` says whether the sites are new.
